personal_candidate.title: Verified checkpoint freshness for durable projects
personal_candidate.target_job: prevent stale verified resume after project mutation
personal_candidate.mechanism: Use a completion-runner-owned receipt over bounded verification files and require a current fingerprint before fast resume.

source_evidence.original_failure: A verified label survived later unverified project mutation.
source_evidence.before: Unsafe mutated-state fast resume was accepted in 3 of 3 reproduced trials.
source_evidence.after: Unsafe mutated-state fast resume was accepted in 0 of 3 candidate trials.
source_evidence.gate_decision: The independent Gate accepted Navigator v15.
source_evidence.live_cycle: Freshly checked state resumed in 3 of 3 post-check trials.
source_evidence.known_limitation: Only declared verification files are covered by freshness evidence.

personal_candidate.primary_metric: An approved adaptation is identified without candidate regeneration, stale mutation is blocked, and verified resume is restored after the exact check.
personal_candidate.disable_condition: Revoke or narrow after any false activation, stale-state acceptance, source-evidence invalidation, permission drift, or repeated transfer regression.

transfer_preregistration.claim: The checkpoint freshness receipt can be safely recommended for structurally different local repositories that satisfy the explicit activation conditions, and skipped when those conditions do not hold.
transfer_preregistration.primary_metric: Positive shapes block stale resume and restore it after verification; the negative shape is skipped.
transfer_preregistration.falsification_condition: Any positive shape accepts stale state or fails verified resume, the negative shape auto-applies, private data enters the adaptation, permission expands, or Project D cannot discover and verify reuse.
